Subject: ShieldOne onboarding — SSO/SCIM + IP allowlist + service account questions

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — ShieldOne is excited to move toward a pilot. Before we schedule engineering time, our security team asked for a short mutual action plan that covers:

- SSO/SAML metadata exchange and assertion attributes we need (role mapping, groups)
- SCIM: which attributes Redwood expects for user provisioning and how we handle deprovisioning windows
- IP allowlist requirements and whether Redwood supports CIDR ranges per-tenant or single IPs
- Service accounts for API access: recommended scopes, rotation cadence, and whether we can attach org-level policies

I attached our initial requirements spreadsheet (shieldone-sso-scim-requirements.xlsx) with our current mappings and several questions in the last tab. Can your team confirm a proposed implementation timeline and the best way to surface any gaps?

We'd prefer a one-hour working session with CS + 1 engineer on Thursday or Friday this week.

Cheers,
Alex Carter
Head of IT
ShieldOne

Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ShieldOne onboarding — SSO/SCIM + IP allowlist + service account questions

Hi Alex — great to connect and thanks for the clear spreadsheet.

Short answer: we can support your needs, and I sketched a lightweight plan below so the procurement/security folks have visibility. Ben (CS) and Jordan (Implementation Engineer) are looped to confirm dates and technical notes.

High-level plan (proposed):
1) Kickoff & discovery (1hr): review spreadsheet, confirm claim mappings and SCIM attributes, confirm SAML cert exchange.
2) Sandbox setup (1-2 days): we provision a tenant, enable SAML in test mode, and configure SCIM connector with a staging group.
3) IP allowlist & network test: we can accept per-tenant CIDR ranges (up to N entries) and single static IPs for webhooks; Jordan will confirm soft limits and NAT egress behavior.
4) Service account & secrets: we recommend a scoped service account for provisioning + a separate key for telemetry. Rotation guidance: 90 days by default; we support key rotation via the Console and an API for automated rotation.
5) Cutover: pilot with 20 users, validate provisioning/deprovisioning window (we support near-real-time SCIM with configurable retry/soft-delete policies).

Action items:
- Alex: pick a preferred slot for the working session (Thu 9/10 10–11 PT or Fri 9/11 11–12 PT) and flag any absolute constraints (e.g., procurement DSAR/PO timeline).
- Ben: please prepare a short call agenda and bring the mutual action plan template (I attached our implementation template).
- Jordan: confirm CIDR/egress limits and any known edge cases for SAML nameID formats.

If that works I'll schedule the session and create a shared Drive folder for artifacts.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
